rules.statement: An alienation of land after an interlocutory order in a partition action is not necessarily void under section 17 of the Partition Ordinance, but depends on whether the Court has refused to grant the application by its final decree.
rules.supporting_quote: 'It is conceded that the term "owner" includes all owners, whether parties to the suit or not. But it is urged that the moment the Court had made a decree for partition it could not alter it, and thereafter the ordinary rule of lis pendens would apply, as the Court could not then make an order refusing the application.'
